evidence.independence: The CNMC July 2026 note says Vodafone's net portability was negative (https://cnmc.es/sites/default/files/editor_contenidos/Notas%20de%20prensa/2026/20260923_NP_Mensual%20telecos%20julio%202026.pdf), and Finetwork brand litigation with Wewi Mobile continues (https://dplnews.com/espana-wewi-mobile-incumple-el-plazo-para-devolver-la-marca-finetwork-a-vodafone/).

evidence.text: The yoy comparison for Q2 is the hardest of the year. Zegona's own disclosures show Vodafone Spain EBITDAaL of EUR349m for the three months to Sept 2025, against EUR316m in Q1 FY26 and EUR313m in Q3 FY26. Repeating Q1 FY27's EUR324m run-rate plus seasonality could print flat-to-low growth against Q1's +3%.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: ZEG fell 4.0% on Q1 FY27, when EBITDAaL growth was +3% and EBITDA +5%. Decelerating profit growth has not been rewarded.
evidence.why_not_priced: Analysts who model the quarter will have the seasonality, so this matters mainly for the headline yoy figure retail and quant readers see. The definitions may not be identical (the Q3 FY26 table excluded Finetwork; Q1 FY27 includes it), which caps it small. It is an inference from primary documents, not a known miss.
evidence.independence: Q1 FY26 316 and Q1 FY27 324 come from a separate RNS (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/zegona-communications--zeg/fy27-quarter-1-results/9668915). The independence is weak because both are the company's own figures.

evidence.text: Spanish press reported in September that Telefonica had reactivated talks to buy Vodafone Espana from Zegona. No formal offer has been made, and the two sides' valuations sit about EUR7bn apart (about EUR8bn against about EUR15bn). The interim or its call may carry the first management comment since then.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 14 Sep 2026 report had no clear single-day effect I could isolate. The stock ran from 1672p (27 Oct) to 1886p (4 Nov) and gave it back by 6 Nov with no RNS. Cause unexplained, worth 0.
evidence.why_not_priced: The talks are public and the stock carries some optionality for them. No offer period exists (no Rule 2.4), so what the window can deliver is commentary of either sign. A 'not for sale at this price' line is as likely as an 'open to value-maximising options' line, so it is sized 0 with a wide band.
evidence.independence: Roams (16 Sep 2026) repeats the reactivation and the price gap (https://roams.es/actualidad/telefonia/telefonica-reactiva-compra-vodafone-zegona-vale-mucho-mas/), but it rests on the same reporting.

evidence.text: The EUR200m buyback is running at 40-50k shares a day through Canaccord (240k shares, 9-13 Nov, VWAP 1,750.66p), about 10% of daily volume, and continues mechanically on results day.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The day the buyback and dividend framework was announced (24 Sep 2026), ZEG fell 3.2%. Capital returns have been sold as news.
evidence.why_not_priced: Fully public and weekly disclosed. It is filed only as a small, dated flow cushion on the day, not as information.
evidence.independence: The programme terms are in the 24 Sep RNS (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/zegona-communications--zeg/new-capital-allocation-framework/9787930).
